title: Validation of ECHOREPO software components against explicit acceptance criteria
baseline: M40 (2026-09-30); current-run tests are NOT retrospective M40 evidence

components.name: REST API and query validation
components.criterion: Public health probe works; protected canonical requests reject unauthenticated clients; API key works; invalid selectors and filters fail before DB access.
components.additional_evidence: Integration against staging PostgreSQL and a deployed API; test real filter/count consistency.

components.name: Web application access
components.criterion: Anonymous access redirects to login safely; POST is not replayed; logged-in users can reach protected routes.
components.additional_evidence: Browser-based workflow and usability acceptance tests on deployed /explore, /search and /my pages.

components.name: Canonical data exports
components.criterion: Six published CSV schemas agree across producer, validator and publisher; ZIP is parseable with no comment prefix; filtering IDs normalizes; parameter threshold is respected.
components.additional_evidence: Real snapshot row-count, foreign-key and value validation using an immutable dataset bundle.

components.name: Soil data harmonisation
components.criterion: Multilingual soil texture values map to documented canonical vocabulary; unsupported categories rejected.
components.additional_evidence: Representative field-to-lab sample reconciliation and semantic validation with external vocabularies.

components.name: Data quality controls
components.criterion: Default/malformed coordinates, duplicate samples, invalid types and wrong header schemas are detected.
components.additional_evidence: QA report on the M40 archive with defect counts, dispositions and reviewer signatures.

components.name: Geospatial and privacy safeguards
components.criterion: Malformed locations are excluded from map output; coordinate jitter is reproducible and bounded.
components.additional_evidence: Payload review for personal data, access rules and adversarial location disclosure; privacy risk assessment.

components.name: CSVW metadata and Zenodo preparation
components.criterion: CSVW metadata describes all canonical resource schemas and rejects inconsistent headers.
components.additional_evidence: Offline --dry-run of complete publication workflow; DOI/record evidence; external CSVW interoperability.

components.name: MinIO storage
components.criterion: Object paths reject traversal, snapshots target dated/latest paths, responses release connections.
components.additional_evidence: Actual MinIO read/write/restore integration and access policy checks.

components.name: Laboratory data ingestion
components.criterion: Sample QR normalization consistent; oversized uploads rejected before DB access.
components.additional_evidence: Staging DB upsert, idempotence, authorization, rollback and per-field lineage tests.

components.name: Database migrations
components.criterion: Migration ledger uses bound filename parameters for queries and writes.
components.additional_evidence: Fresh PostgreSQL 16 migration test and restore-from-backup exercise.

components.name: Usage analytics
components.criterion: IP addresses are consistently pseudonymized for usage statistics.
components.additional_evidence: Aggregate event ingestion, retention, access policy and dashboard checks on staging.

components.name: Biodiversity import and upload
components.criterion: Uploads are bounded and content-exact; auth separation and queueing verified using mocks.
components.additional_evidence: Existing queue/PostgreSQL integration suite, 16S/ITS pipeline processing and scientific outputs.

components.name: Server-side sessions
components.criterion: Opaque cookie does not expose tokens; session IDs rotate and logout revokes.
components.additional_evidence: Secure live HTTPS cookie configuration, Keycloak login/logout and concurrency stress checks.

components.name: JupyterHub edge authentication
components.criterion: Unauthenticated/unauthorised users denied; authorised subject header only emitted on success.
components.additional_evidence: Deployment-level notebook isolation, permissions, networking and resource limits.

components.name: LOESS overlay
components.criterion: GeoJSON coordinates and status filters correct; accepted public photo links populated without user PII.
components.additional_evidence: Deployed map overlay/manual browser acceptance checks and scheduled refresh logs.

components.name: Multilingual user interface
components.criterion: LOESS translation labels registered and fallback/format substitutions validated.
components.additional_evidence: Language-switching smoke tests across the deployed application and accessibility review.

components.name: Optional Streamlit research explorer
components.criterion: Explore canonical sample properties from authenticated backend without exposing private data.
components.additional_evidence: Not covered by this initial R7-1 automated suite; need isolated Streamlit application and access integration tests.

components.name: External dependencies and publication interoperability
components.criterion: Deployed PostgreSQL, Keycloak, Firebase and Zenodo interfaces work as specified.
components.additional_evidence: External staging/live tests with explicit authorisation and traceable logs. SoilWise/JRC/EOSC are separately scoped commitments.
